source.lineEndingNote: Measured Windows CRLF bytes and canonical Git LF source are equivalent

selection.runtime: sherpa-onnx/core 1.12.40 Windows CPython 3.12, native CPU ONNX implementation behind isolated Python boundary
selection.keywords: English GigaSpeech 3.3M INT8 chunk16 plus zh-en 3M FP32 chunk8; English-only graphs; complementary Ivy graphs, phoneme controls; 8 active command paths
selection.transcriber: English-only Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 INT8, 2 CPU threads
selection.rationale: Parakeet has substantially lower measured warm compute latency than cached Whisper Base. This synthetic corpus shows 7 versus 6 word errors, so no accuracy improvement is claimed; retain draft status pending representative real speech qualification.
selection.alternatives: Exploratory English BPE-only controls and either single wake graph exposed misses. Full NeMo/PyTorch is unnecessary for this supported native ONNX model. openWakeWord has no supplied Ivy classifier; custom training and holdout recordings remain a possible follow-up, not a qualified model.

licenses.parakeet: CC-BY-4.0; attribution, license link and ONNX conversion/quantization notice required on redistribution
licenses.processWrapAndWindows: MIT OR Apache-2.0; safe suspended Windows Job Object API; no handwritten unsafe code

selection.packaging: Explicit SHA-checked archives and hash-pinned wheels; application never installs/downloads. Current desktop installer remains disabled; weights are outside tracked source.

searchWidthQualification.scope: Same fixed synthetic corpus; no live accuracy claim

method.speedLimit: Resampling changes pitch as well as speed; these are not independent natural pronunciations
method.latencyReference: Last PCM sample above absolute amplitude 262; wake-request keyword end is unannotated
method.latencyLimit: Audio-time replay availability excludes renderer/native IPC, scheduling and physical microphone delay. Post-Ivy request keyword ends are not annotated and have null latency.
method.wordErrors: Case/punctuation normalized word edit distance on 48 normal-speed clips, 202 reference words
method.baselineLimit: One-request Whisper includes interpreter/model startup. Cached Whisper separately removes repeated model loading; Parakeet replay includes PCM conversion and warm model execution.

summary.target250ms: Not consistently achieved; decoder chunk/lookahead and phrase settlement add material delay
summary.fallbackLimit: Active-session misses may use the slower exact finalized-STT command route. They are still fast-path misses; no complete fallback success rate is claimed. Passive misses remain passive.

nativeWorker.resourceScope: Sum of root launcher and all recursive descendants; RSS may double-count shared pages
nativeWorker.scope: Rust-owned persistent CPU workers; no WebView IPC or live microphone

fixture.kind: Previously generated fixed synthetic probe; 31 repeated identical requests

nativeWorker.memoryLimitations: Allocator/RSS grows after cold request and remains about 859-864 MiB over 30 warm requests. This finite run does not prove absence of leaks.

warmWhisperComparator.scope: Existing worker/configuration with one cached Whisper Base CPU INT8 model; no process/IPC cost
